''simultaneous broadcast'' | runtime = | ratings = | producer = | director = | website = {{URL|www.sagawards.org}} | image2 = | image2size = | alt2 = | caption2 = | previous = [[14th Screen Actors Guild Awards|14th]] | main = [[Screen Actors Guild Awards]] | next = [[16th Screen Actors Guild Awards|16th]] }} The 15th Annual [[Screen Actors Guild Awards]], honoring the best achievements in film and television performances for the year 2008, were presented on January 25, 2009.{{cite press release|title=15th Annual SAG Awards Recipients |url=http://www.sagawards.org/media-pr/press-releases/15th-annual-sag-awards%C2%AE-recipients |publisher=[[Screen Actors Guild]] |access-date=January 8, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150922054942/http://www.sagawards.org/media-pr/press-releases/15th-annual-sag-awards%C2%AE-recipients |archive-date=September 22, 2015 |location=Los Angeles |date=January 25, 2009 |url-status=dead}} The ceremony was held at the [[Shrine Auditorium|Shrine Exposition Center]] in [[Los Angeles]], California for the thirteenth consecutive year. It was broadcast live simultaneously by [[TNT (American TV network)|TNT]] and [[TBS (American TV channel)|TBS]]. The nominees were announced on December 18, 2008, by [[Angela Bassett]] and [[Eric McCormack]] at Los Angeles' Pacific Design Center's Silver Screen Theater.{{cite press release|title=Nominations Announced for the 15th Annual SAG Awards |url=http://www.sagawards.org/media-pr/press-releases/nominations-announced-15th-annual-sag-awards%C2%AE |publisher=[[Screen Actors Guild]] |access-date=January 8, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150922075934/http://www.sagawards.org/media-pr/press-releases/nominations-announced-15th-annual-sag-awards%C2%AE |archive-date=September 22, 2015 |location=Los Angeles |date=December 18, 2008 |url-status=dead}} ''[[Doubt (2008 film)|Doubt]]'' received the highest number of nominations among the film categories with five, four for individual performances and one for ensemble performance.{{cite news |url=http://goldderby.latimes.com/awards_goldderby/2008/12/sag-nominations.html |title=SAG Awards nominations embrace Brangelina, snub Leo |first=Tom |last=O'Neil |access-date=2008-12-18 |date=2008-12-18 |work=[[Los Angeles Times]]| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20081221042503/http://goldderby.latimes.com/awards_goldderby/2008/12/sag-nominations.html| archive-date= 21 December 2008 }} In the television categories, ''[[Boston Legal]]'', ''[[30 Rock]]'', ''[[John Adams (miniseries)|John Adams]]'', ''[[Mad Men]]'' and ''[[The Closer]]'' had the most nominations with three each.{{cite news| url=https://www.cbsnews.com/news/doubt-tops-sag-pack/ | work=CBS News | title='Doubt' Tops SAG Pack | date=2008-12-18| access-date= 22 January 2011| url-status=live | archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20110129064829/http://www.cbsnews.com/stories/2008/12/18/entertainment/awards/main4675230.shtml| archive-date= 29 January 2011 }} The biggest winner of the evening was ''30 Rock'', which won in all three categories in which it was nominated. ''[[The Dark Knight]]'' won the most film awards, winning in both categories in which it was nominated. ==Winners and nominees== Winners are listed first and highlighted in '''boldface'''.
